context_for_next_testing_agent: Gallery tap-to-navigate + dot-tap works reliably on web preview. Verified pattern: login via POST /api/auth/login, set localStorage.gt_token, navigate directly to /hotspot/{id}. Use `document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=\"hotspot-gallery-img\"]')` and inspect inner .src to prove which slide is active in DOM order; combined with the visible '{i+1} / 5 photos' counter and dot width (active=18px) it uniquely identifies pageIdx. Screenshots stored under /tmp/02..05_*.png in this run.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: outer vertical ScrollView on hotspot detail was swallowing the FlatList's horizontal pan on both mobile and web, so pagingEnabled swipes only worked intermittently and users were stuck on photo 1/5. Fix (already applied by main agent) adds two invisible Pressable tap zones (left/right halves of hero, testIDs hotspot-gallery-prev/-next), makes each pagination dot a Pressable (testID hotspot-gallery-dot-{i}), adds directionalLockEnabled to the outer ScrollView, and getItemLayout to the FlatList so scrollToIndex is synchronous. Retest confirms taps reliably drive pageIdx state -> scrollToIndex -> onMomentumScrollEnd stays consistent. Swipe remains as best-effort fallback.
